interpretations: For each site with a recorded insurance status, average its nonmissing mesh-level values of `facetresmm / geomdeltamm` and count all its mesh records. Within each insurance status, average those site ratios with each site weighted equally. Report each status with at least one site whose ratio strictly exceeds that status average, together with the mean ratio of those sites, their count, and their mean excess over the status average.
queries:
WITH site_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        s.zoneregistry,
        s.insurstat,
        AVG(m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS site_ratio,
        COUNT(m.facetregistry) AS mesh_count
    FROM sites AS s
    LEFT JOIN scanmesh AS m
        ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
    WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat
),
status_averages AS (
    SELECT
        insurstat,
        AVG(site_ratio) AS status_ratio
    FROM site_ratios
    GROUP BY insurstat
)
SELECT
    sr.insurstat,
    AVG(sr.site_ratio) AS mean_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS site_count,
    AVG(sr.site_ratio - sa.status_ratio) AS mean_excess
FROM site_ratios AS sr
JOIN status_averages AS sa
    ON sa.insurstat = sr.insurstat
WHERE sr.site_ratio > sa.status_ratio
GROUP BY sr.insurstat
